issue_summary.title: Fix table export failure when active date filters are applied
issue_summary.beginner_explanation: Users attempting to export report data while filtering by date experience silent failures. The serializer appears to misinterpret or reject date range parameters.
issue_summary.expected_outcome: CSV file exports cleanly reflecting whatever date range or filters the user has active.
acceptance_criteria: Export initiates correctly when date range filters are active
Exported CSV contents match the filtered records exactly
Appropriate error notification is displayed if serialization fails
unknowns: Does this affect other export formats (e.g. JSON/PDF) or strictly CSV?
